# Know when to sow, which weeks overflow the bench, and what more space would earn.

> Free greenhouse and nursery planner: enter what you promised to sell and when, and get sow dates, bench and germination space by week, what will not fit and what extra space is worth. Private, runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/greenhouse-bench-planner/)

## Limits

- The plan is a fast search, not a proven optimum: orders are booked by margin per square foot-week of space, then other booking orders and single-crop moves are tried and kept when they earn more. On the built-in example it matches the best of all 5,040 booking orders ($4,548 margin, 1,723 of 1,870 units).
- Holding a finished crop, and selling one late, are each capped at 52 weeks; the plan says so when it caps an entry.
